name: Slab sniper
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, crouched behind a narrow upright slab of grey road stone with a thin slit in it, one yellow eye squinting through the slit, a white-hot dart held ready

poses.stand: crouched low behind the narrow upright stone slab, one eye peering through the slit in it, wings folded
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: crouches behind its slab, the eye in the slit shifting left and right

attack.action: squints through the slit, then pokes a claw through and flicks a thin white-hot dart forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
